title: Military Watch Magazine — 'North Korea to Field World's Fifth Largest Destroyer Fleet By 2032, Overtaking Russia, France and UK'
snippet: Military Watch Magazine analyzed North Korea's naval expansion plans centered on the Choe Hyon-class destroyers. Based on current build rates and announced plans from the 9th Party Congress, North Korea could operate the world's fifth largest destroyer fleet by 2032, overtaking Russia, France, and the UK. The analysis connects the destroyer program with North Korea's nuclear-armed naval strategy, including nuclear-tipped strategic cruise missiles and tactical ballistic missiles. This represents a significant expansion of North Korea's blue-water naval capabilities.
tag_reason: 이전 7일 소스에 동일/유사 항목 없음. 5/20 보고서의 최현호 구축함 분석과 맥락적 연결이 있으나, 2032년 세계 5위 구축함 함대 전망은 새로운 분석. 북한 해군 핵 투사 능력 장기 전망이라는 새 정보 포함.
